description: Find competitions, teams and players on betrend by name (any language, at least 2 characters). Returns each match with its betrend.im URL; pass a competition or team URL to the other tools. Covers sports only.

query.description: Name to look for, e.g. "Arsenal", "Premier League", "Virat Kohli".

types.description: Limit to these kinds. Default: all three.

name: search

as_of.description: When betrend produced this answer, UTC ISO 8601.

has_more.description: Present and true when more items exist than returned; narrow the filters.

notice.description: How to narrow the request when truncated.

detail.description: Sport and country, or club and country for players.

url.description: betrend.im page URL; pass competition or team URLs to the other tools.

truncated.description: Present and true when the longest list was cut to keep the answer under 20000 bytes.

title: Search sports
